sources.title: ArcGIS REST layer metadata for baseline AAFC feature service layer 0
sources.license_or_reuse: Open Government Licence - Canada as stated in linked source item
sources.finding_or_limit: Fields include ecoregion, ecozone and ecoprovince IDs and official EN/FR names. Service dataLastEditDate is 2025-12-18; schema/item edit dates are later. This helps explain why the current source display/metadata vintage differs from the 2023 edition GeoJSON comparison. Raw JSON is retained losslessly in deterministic gzip so source formatting whitespace does not fail diff hygiene.
